guides.title: 工程檔案：關鍵數據、年代、規範與案例
guides.titleEn: Engineering dossier: key figures, timeline, codes and landmarks
guides.concept: 主孔服務孔介面、壓力波與長期可維護性。本頁區分公開工程資料與明示的教學假設；數值只用於學習比較，不是設計值。
guides.conceptEn: Running-bore and service-gallery interfaces, pressure waves and maintainability. This dossier distinguishes public project facts from explicitly labelled teaching assumptions; figures are for learning comparisons, not design values.
facts: 公開工程尺度約為 50 km，保留所列來源的計量邊界。
1994 年事件：英法海底隧道開放，建立海峽兩岸固定鐵路連結。
教學「測壓水頭」：水密度=1000 kg/m³，其餘輸入依單元，結果=333.54 kPa；不是實測或允收值。
教學「襯砌環向壓縮」：均勻外壓=0.32 MPa，其餘輸入依單元，結果=2.83429 MPa；不是實測或允收值。
教學「通風顯熱量」：空氣密度=1.2 kg/m³，其餘輸入依單元，結果=1186.7 kW；不是實測或允收值。
教學「入口壓力擾動」：空氣密度=1.2 kg/m³，其餘輸入依單元，結果=1008.6 Pa；不是實測或允收值。
factsEn: The public scale is about 50 km; retain the measurement boundary in the cited source.
1994 event: The Channel Tunnel opens as a fixed railway connection across the Channel.
Teaching piezometric head: water density=1000 kg/m³, with remaining inputs as in the unit, gives 333.54 kPa; not measured or accepted project data.
Teaching lining hoop compression: uniform external pressure=0.32 MPa, with remaining inputs as in the unit, gives 2.83429 MPa; not measured or accepted project data.
Teaching ventilation sensible heat: air density=1.2 kg/m³, with remaining inputs as in the unit, gives 1186.7 kW; not measured or accepted project data.
Teaching portal pressure disturbance: air density=1.2 kg/m³, with remaining inputs as in the unit, gives 1008.6 Pa; not measured or accepted project data.

2026　教材檢視：核對公開尺度並撰寫假想算例，這不是工程完工日期。
timelineEn: 1994 — The Channel Tunnel opens as a fixed railway connection across the Channel
2009 — Method reference: FHWA publishes its civil tunnel manual; this is not a project construction milestone.
2026 — Educational review: public scales are checked and hypothetical exercises authored, not a project completion date.
codes: FHWA-NHI-10-034：道路隧道土建技術手冊，供公開原理比較。
PIARC 道路隧道手冊：系統、營運與維護，須核對跨領域適用性。
codesEn: FHWA-NHI-10-034: Technical Manual for Road Tunnel Civil Elements, for public principles.
PIARC Road Tunnels Manual: systems, operations and maintenance; verify cross-domain applicability.
procedure: 把關鍵數據與本課算例逐項對照，標出哪些是公開工程數據、哪些是教學假設。
沿著工程時間軸，標出設計、施工、事件與維護改造的關鍵決策點，說明每個決策改變了哪一條系統路徑或檢核。
對照列出的規範與標準，找出本課試驗或允收步驟對應的條款類型，並註明版本與適用地區。
從代表工程中選一個與本課比較，列出埋深或斷面、地質水文、支護系統與施工方法的差異。
procedureEn: Compare the key figures with this course's worked example and mark which are public project data and which are teaching assumptions.
Along the timeline, mark the key design, construction, event and retrofit decisions and say which system path or check each one changed.
Against the listed codes and standards, find the kind of clause behind this course's tests or acceptance steps, noting edition and jurisdiction.
Pick one landmark project to compare with this course and list differences in depth or section, ground and groundwater, support system and construction method.
pitfalls: 把四捨五入的公開數據當成設計值或允收值使用。
沒有確認規範版本、適用地區與荷載組合就直接套用另一國的條文。
pitfallsEn: Using rounded public figures as design or acceptance values.
Applying another country's clauses without checking edition, jurisdiction and load combinations.

guides.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
guides.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

guides.title: 機制、算例與驗證：英法海底隧道
guides.titleEn: Mechanisms, calculations and verification: Channel Tunnel
guides.concept: 英法海底隧道讓客貨列車與車輛接駁列車通過英吉利海峽，營運商列長約50公里並記錄1994年啟用。本進階課把海底水壓、襯砌接縫、熱量、氣動擾動與維修可用率連成同一系統，特別比較主孔與服務通道的任務差異，避免把各設備單獨合格當整體服務可靠。
guides.conceptEn: The approximately 50 km Channel Tunnel carries passenger, freight and vehicle-shuttle trains beneath the English Channel and opened in 1994. This advanced course links subsea pressure, lining joints, heat, aerodynamic disturbances and maintenance availability. It distinguishes the duties of running bores and service access, showing why individual equipment compliance does not by itself establish a reliable operating system.
procedure: 英法海底案例先區分海面水深與岩層測壓水頭，避免把海床幾何直接當襯砌各處水壓；服務通道排水也會影響局部梯度。水壓取決於連通含水層的測壓水頭，不必等於地表或海面至洞頂的幾何深度。排水降低水壓卻可能增加有效應力與沉陷；停泵或排水堵塞後水頭又會回升，因此防水、排水及環境保水是互相制約的設計選擇。
比較英法主孔及服務通道的襯砌尺度，幾何縮小雖改變膜應力量級，接頭轉角、局部荷載及維修開口仍須獨立評估。圓形襯砌對均勻外壓可主要以環向壓縮抵抗，但接頭轉動、偏壓與背填空隙會引起彎矩。薄環膜應力只說明其中一條受力路徑；脫模、運輸、頂推及永久狀態的荷載不同，環片局部接觸與止水條件必須另外檢核。
服務通道與主孔間的連接令止水介面不只沿圓環分布，教學比較規則接縫和分岔部位的變形相容，不能只按平均寬度分類。止水條依受控壓縮維持連續接觸，接縫轉角、錯台、污染與材料鬆弛都會降低最不利點的接觸能力。平均壓縮量不能掩蓋局部脫離；全尺寸試驗的結果只對測試過的幾何、水壓及荷載歷程有效，幾何餘量本身並不是接觸壓力。
長海底隧道的維修物流需在列車服務與服務通道使用間協調，備料的距離和返回時間會影響實際工作窗口，不只看工具進入時間。多工作面只有在供電、通風、出渣與材料供應同步充足時才增加總產量。共用豎井或軌道形成串聯瓶頸，排隊和維修窗口會降低名目容量；緩衝區太大又可能侵占通行與救援空間，因此不能單純把各面產能相加。
英法列車與設備熱源會隨服務密度改變，分析正常高峰和一條冷卻路徑維修時的空氣及水側熱帳，避免把裝置容量直接視為可移除熱量。深部岩體、列車和機械會向空氣持續放熱，空氣帶走的顯熱由質量流量與溫升決定。相同體積風量在不同密度下不具有相同散熱能力；濕度、岩體瞬變及水冷系統還需分開記帳，單一穩態熱平衡不能預測全部溫度尖峰。
英法主孔的列車種類與速度不同，阻塞比和交會情境應分案；服務通道門位又會改變壓力反射邊界，不能用單一動壓替代波動歷程。列車進洞壓縮前方空氣，波動在洞口、橫通道和斷面變化處傳播與反射。速度和阻塞比影響壓力量級，但不可壓動壓只是比較尺度，不能替代可壓縮瞬變計算；兩車交會、門位與列車外形都可能改變乘客及設備的壓力歷程。
英法服務通道提供不同於運行孔的接收空間，疏散模型需確認到達之後的人流容量與可用狀態，不能在越過第一道門時就結束計時。疏散時間包含辨識、反應、移動及排隊，不只由出口距離決定。人員速度會受煙熱、能見度及行動能力影響，安全判斷還要比較可用安全時間；橫通道存在但門或鄰孔不可用時，圖上的最短路線不一定能作實際選擇。
海底排水的可靠性需連結低點集水、供電與維修隔離，假想兩台泵中一台退出時，分析淨入流與警報延遲而不把原容量沿用。集水坑在泵停止後提供有限緩衝，剩餘容積需扣除初始水量、沉積及不可用死角。緩衝時間取決於淨入流，不是名牌抽水能力；警報延遲、備援切換與水量突增會消耗餘裕，排水電力又可能與其他安全設備共用失效原因。
英法跨境服務把電力、控制、冷卻與維修責任放在多個介面，設備重複不能消除共用軟體或配電故障，需以功能可用性定義頂事件。兩套設備只有在故障近似獨立且切換可靠時，並聯才顯著降低不可用率。共用配電、控制軟體、冷卻或受淹位置會把獨立假設破壞；維修停用也改變當下配置，因此可靠度模型必須明列共有資源和設備狀態，不能只數備用台數。
英法長期營運需要把更新設備與原設施共同管理，資料交接必須保留新舊版本適用里程及日期，不能讓歷史趨勢因供應商更換而中斷。地下設備的竣工資料必須讓維護人員找到正確位置、材料批次和控制版本。只有上傳圖面而沒有變更歷程，無法分辨元件替換與真正劣化；告警、儀器、線路及工單使用一致識別碼，才可能把量測趨勢連回實際受力或水力系統。
procedureEn: Distinguish seawater depth from rock piezometric head, including local gradients affected by service-gallery drainage rather than equating seabed geometry with pressure everywhere. Water pressure follows piezometric head in the connected aquifer, not automatically the geometric depth below ground or sea level. Drainage reduces pressure but can increase effective stress and settlement. Head may recover after a pump outage or blockage, coupling waterproofing, drainage capacity and preservation of surrounding groundwater in the permanent design.

Compare lining scales in running bores and service access; geometric scaling changes membrane stress but does not preserve joint rotations, local loads or maintenance-opening behaviour. A circular lining resists uniform external pressure largely through hoop compression, but joint rotation, uneven load and backfill voids generate bending. Thin-ring membrane stress describes only one load path. Demoulding, transport, jacking and permanent states impose different actions, requiring separate checks of local segment contact and sealing rather than one permanent-load calculation.

Connections between service access and running bores create nonuniform interfaces; compare regular joints with branch movement compatibility rather than classifying seals by mean gap alone. A gasket seals through controlled continuous compression; rotation, offset, contamination and relaxation reduce contact at the weakest point. Average compression cannot compensate for local separation. Full-size test results apply only to their tested geometry, head and load history, while a calculated geometric reserve is neither contact pressure nor evidence of watertightness.

Maintenance logistics must fit railway service and service-access use; material distance and return time constrain the window beyond the time needed to bring tools inside. Multiple headings increase output only when power, air, muck transport and materials support them together. Shared shafts or railways become serial bottlenecks, while queues and maintenance reduce nominal capacity. Large buffers may obstruct personnel and rescue access, so face capacities cannot simply be added without a network-level transport and storage check.

Traffic-dependent heat must be reconciled across air and water during peaks and cooling-path maintenance rather than equating installed capacity with removable heat. Deep rock, trains and machinery release heat to the air, whose sensible removal depends on mass flow and temperature rise. Equal volumetric flow at different density does not provide equal cooling. Moisture, transient rock heat and water cooling need separate accounts; a steady balance cannot predict every temperature peak or local worker exposure.

Different train types, speeds and encounter cases change blockage and wave behaviour; service-access door states also alter reflections beyond a single dynamic-pressure estimate. A train entering a tunnel compresses the air ahead, producing waves reflected at portals, passages and section changes. Speed and blockage influence magnitude, but incompressible dynamic pressure is only a comparison scale, not a compressible transient solution. Train encounters, door states and vehicle shape change the pressure histories experienced by passengers and equipment.

Service access provides a receiving space distinct from the running bore; evacuation modelling must include capacity and availability after the first doorway, not stop its clock there. Evacuation includes detection, response, travel and queues, not merely distance to an exit. Smoke, visibility and mobility alter walking speed, while safety requires comparison with available safe time. A passage shown on a plan may be unusable because its door or receiving bore is unavailable, invalidating the nominal shortest route.

Link low-point sumps, power and maintenance isolation; when one hypothetical pump is unavailable, recalculate net inflow and alarm delay rather than retaining the original capacity. A sump offers finite buffering after pumps stop, with usable volume reduced by initial water, sediment and dead spaces. Buffer time depends on net inflow rather than pump nameplate capacity. Alarm delay, transfer time and inflow surges consume reserve, while shared electrical dependencies may disable drainage and other safety equipment together.

Cross-border service couples power, controls, cooling and maintenance responsibilities; duplicated equipment does not eliminate shared software or distribution faults, so define top events by lost function. Parallel equipment sharply reduces unavailability only when failures are approximately independent and transfer works. Shared power, software, cooling or flood exposure breaks that assumption. Planned maintenance also changes the available configuration, so reliability models must identify shared resources and states rather than count spare units or multiply unsupported independent probabilities.

Long-term renewal requires old and new systems to coexist in records, with chainage and dates defining each revision rather than losing historical trends when suppliers change. Handover must let maintainers find the correct location, material batch and control revision. Drawings without change history cannot distinguish replacement from deterioration. Consistent identifiers across alarms, instruments, circuits and work orders are essential for linking trends to the physical structural or hydraulic system instead of treating each record as an isolated file.
evidence: 本案「測壓水頭」的交付需回答：將主孔與服務孔測壓點用同一高程和潮位基準比較，檢查水頭相位差是否支持連通假設。設計檢核應分列正常排水、堵塞與停電水位，將環境受體的容許變化和監測責任一起交付，不把抽水量當唯一指標。
本案「襯砌環向壓縮」的交付需回答：分別建立兩種斷面的接頭模型，將同水頭下環向變形與開口附近局部應變對照。設計圖應分開標註各施工階段、接頭剛度及背填條件，構件驗收同時核對幾何、材料批次與止水試驗適用包絡。
本案「止水壓縮餘量」的交付需回答：在接縫轉角及分岔附近保存錯台方向，選全尺寸測試中真正對應的組合，而非只比水壓。保存接縫幾何與試驗壓力的配對紀錄，由設計者核定允收包絡；驗收時不能把課堂的幾何餘量當產品認證數字。
本案「出渣運輸節拍」的交付需回答：用工單時間戳分開進入、作業、清點及撤出，核對共用路線是否在同一窗口被另一任務占用。每日排程同時標示人員、材料和維修的占用時段，任何物流改線先檢查通風與應變通道，不能只看運量提升。
本案「通風顯熱量」的交付需回答：配對列車通過時段、設備功率、進出口溫差和流量，檢查熱量殘差是否集中在服務高峰。熱帳分別列岩體、交通、機械與水冷路徑，交接時保存季節和負載範圍，設備增設前須重新核對可用散熱能力。
evidenceEn: For Channel Tunnel, the piezometric head handover must address the following evidence: Compare bore and service-gallery piezometers on one elevation and tide datum, testing whether phase differences support hydraulic connectivity. Separate normal drainage, blocked-drain and power-outage heads and hand over receptor limits and monitoring responsibility together rather than using pump flow as the sole indicator.

For Channel Tunnel, the lining hoop compression handover must address the following evidence: Model both jointed sections separately and compare circumferential movement with local strains near openings under matched head. Drawings distinguish stages, joint stiffness and backfill conditions; component acceptance reconciles geometry, material batches and the applicable sealing-test envelope.

For Channel Tunnel, the gasket compression reserve handover must address the following evidence: Retain offset direction at rotated and branched interfaces and select the matching full-size test combination, not pressure alone. Retain paired joint geometry and test pressure, with the designer approving the acceptance envelope; classroom geometric reserves are not product certification values.

For Channel Tunnel, the muck-transport cycle handover must address the following evidence: Separate access, work, inventory checks and withdrawal in work-order timestamps and identify overlapping use of shared routes. Schedules show personnel, materials and maintenance occupancy together; rerouting first checks ventilation and emergency access rather than only throughput gains.

For Channel Tunnel, the ventilation sensible heat handover must address the following evidence: Pair train passages, equipment power, temperature rise and flow, checking whether energy residuals cluster during peak service. Keep rock, traffic, machinery and water-cooling paths separate; retain seasonal and load ranges and reassess cooling capacity before adding equipment.
pitfalls: 潮汐反應滯後若當成儀器故障，會錯過含水層傳遞時間與排水邊界變化。將暫時降水後的低水頭當成永久狀態，會漏掉停泵後外壓回升；過度排水也可能引起周邊地層壓密。
不同方向錯台可能讓密封接觸區遷移，單一正向試驗合格不能證明反向循環後仍水密。扭曲或沾污的止水條可形成旁通通道，即使平均縫寬合格仍可能漏水；盲目灌漿也可能只轉移出水位置。
平均日溫度正常可能遮住列車連續通過的局部熱峰，需保留時間解析度再判斷冷卻不足。把低密度空氣視為海平面空氣會高估散熱，局部熱點也可能被斷面平均溫度掩蓋，導致設備或工作環境超限。
通道本身可用但接收區壅塞時，隊列會回堵主孔，使用單一平均步速會低估所需時間。以最快成人速度套全部旅客會低估需求，若忽略接收孔受煙或車流影響，疏散可能移到另一個危險邊界。
把同一次共同電源故障拆成兩個獨立事件會嚴重低估並聯不可用率，且掩蓋責任介面。重複安裝卻共用單一供電可能在一次故障中全部停機，帳面可靠度很高但實際不可用時間沒有降低。
pitfallsEn: Mistaking tidal lag for sensor failure loses information about aquifer response time and drainage-boundary changes. Treating temporarily lowered head as permanent misses pressure recovery after outage; excessive drainage can also consolidate surrounding ground.

Opposite offsets can shift the sealing contact zone; passing one-direction tests does not prove tightness after reversed cycles. A twisted or contaminated gasket creates bypass leakage despite acceptable mean width; indiscriminate grouting may merely move the outlet.

A normal daily mean can conceal local peaks during successive train passages; retain time resolution before judging cooling adequacy. Assuming sea-level density overstates cooling at low density, while cross-sectional averages hide hot spots affecting equipment and the work environment.

Congestion in an otherwise accessible receiving zone can queue people back into the running bore and defeat an average-speed estimate. Applying the fastest adult speed to everyone understates demand; overlooking smoke or traffic in the receiving bore can transfer evacuees into another hazard.

Splitting one common-supply fault into independent events understates parallel unavailability and hides interface responsibility. Duplicated equipment on one supply can fail together in a single event, leaving actual downtime unchanged despite optimistic calculated reliability.

courses.summary:
英法海底隧道的故事，是讓兩岸測量、地質判讀與地下施工在海底接合。Getlink的歷史紀錄將英國側服務隧道開挖列於1987年，並記下1990年的首次海底貫通及1994年的開幕。

永久系統由兩條行車隧道和中央服務隧道組成，還需通風、排水、供電及維護交通才能提供服務。地圖使用營運者公布的英國端站座標，作為跨國系統的一個可辨識端點；它不是海底所有設施的位置，也不是施工入口指引。
courses.summaryEn:
The Channel Tunnel joined surveys, geological interpretation and underground construction from two shores. Getlink’s history records service-tunnel boring from Britain in 1987, the first undersea breakthrough in 1990 and inauguration in 1994.

The permanent system includes two running tunnels and a central service tunnel, supported by ventilation, drainage, power and maintenance transport. The map uses the operator’s published UK-terminal coordinates as one identifiable endpoint of a cross-border system. It does not locate every undersea facility or provide construction access directions.
courses.connection: 由端站理解系統邊界，再回到地下剖面檢查地層推論、襯砌、水路與三隧道功能。重點是讓土建與機電證據共用位置及狀態。
courses.connectionEn: Use the terminal to understand system boundaries, then review ground inference, lining, water routes and three-bore functions. The key is reconciling civil and service evidence by location and state.
